stem:
Kunal sets up pots of bean seeds for a class experiment.

In which case should the bean seeds germinate?

options.text: In waterlogged soil in sunlight, even though air spaces are almost gone.
In moist, aerated soil kept in the dark.
In dry soil with plenty of air and bright light.
They will not germinate in moist, aerated soil in the dark, because beans need light to sprout.

teacher.key_rationale: Bean seeds need suitable water and air; light is not essential. Waterlogging blocks air; dry soil lacks water; darkness alone does not prevent bean germination.
